SELECT p.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit, c.name AS customer_name FROM scm_price_list p JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = p.material_id LEFT JOIN scm_customer c ON c.id = p.customer_id
(m.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND p.customer_level = #{level}
ORDER BY m.code, p.customer_id, p.customer_level, p.min_qty

SELECT p.* FROM scm_price_list p WHERE p.material_id = #{materialId} AND (p.customer_id IS NULL OR p.customer_id = #{customerId}) AND (p.customer_level IS NULL OR p.customer_level = #{level}) AND COALESCE(p.min_qty, 0) <= #{qty} AND (p.valid_from IS NULL OR p.valid_from <= #{date}) AND (p.valid_to IS NULL OR p.valid_to >= #{date}) ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.customer_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN p.customer_level IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, p.min_qty DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT 1
